verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official CLI that exposes a broad slice of the API as terminal commands in sandbox or production, installed by a one-line script with OAuth auth. It explicitly targets AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and serves as the foundation of AgentOS, with plugin-based installation into agent hosts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's agent workflows (all evidence is vendor docs plus a probe confirming the docs page exists).
